query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `card_scan_history` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`cardId` int,
	`source` enum('line','web','api') NOT NULL,
	`imageUrl` varchar(1000) NOT NULL,
	`imageKey` varchar(500),
	`detectedCardType` varchar(50),
	`extractedText` text,
	`extractedData` json,
	`confidence` int,
	`status` enum('pending','processing','completed','failed','registered') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
	`errorMessage` text,
	`lineMessageId` varchar(255),
	`lineReplyToken` varchar(255),
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `card_scan_history_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
